title: Future Shock Documentary (1972)
summary: The 1972 documentary based on Alvin Toffler's book Future Shock, narrated by Orson Welles. It is a dystopian look at the accelerating pace of technological change and its psychological toll.
why: Recommended as a period piece whose worries about rapid change still feel relevant to current tech anxieties.

quote.text: well worth adding to the list of documentaries to watch. Much of what Toffler/Welles touch is very relevant now.
